<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template identified in task make_7_lvl2-template_search-2 (the Doebner Modification) and then apply it to the target molecule to obtain all possible precursor sets. The target molecule is the product of the Doebner Modification, which is the large aromatic sulfonamide containing the C=C and amide moiety (SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1). We will first search the template catalog for a template that forms a C=C bond (alkene) and breaks a C‑C single bond and a C‑O single bond, which matches the Doebner Modification. Then we will apply the found template to the target molecule to retrieve all precursor combinations.
We need to call search_template_catalog_by_criteria.
